ei.title: Analysis — 아픈 동료를 챙겨준 Chandra의 배려
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Fiona woke up with the worst cough, a sore throat, and a headache. She had to take time off from work, but she knew that taking off today would mean facing a ton of paperwork on her desk tomorrow. Just thinking about it made her headache even worse. Then, the doorbell rang. It was Chandra, her colleague. "No worries, Fiona. I took care of the phone calls and messages, and I even told everyone to think twice before putting any paper on your desk," Chandra said. Surprised, Fiona stared blankly at Chandra. "Here's some chicken noodle soup," Chandra said as she passed Fiona the brown bag she was carrying. "And I bought throat spray and cough drops for you." Fiona wanted to say thanks, but her sore throat held her back. However, Chandra knew exactly what she wanted to say. "No problem, Fiona. I've got your back."

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① take=동사원형(주어 자리 오류), ② made=만들었다(과거), ③ putting=두는 것(동명사), ④ carrying=나르고 있던(진행)
det.analysis:
✅ ① take: 'that take off today would mean...'에서 주어 자리에는 동명사가 필요 — taking(동명사)이 맞음. take(동사원형)는 주어로 쓸 수 없어 오류
❌ ② made: 'Just thinking about it made'에서 동명사 주어 thinking에 대한 과거동사 made 정상
❌ ③ putting: 'before putting any paper'에서 전치사 before 뒤 동명사 정상
❌ ④ carrying: 'the brown bag she was carrying'에서 과거진행 was carrying 정상
det.tip: 동명사구 주어: 'Taking off today'가 주어 → 동사원형 take 불가, taking이어야 함

❌ ③ relative(친척): 가족 관계를 암시하는 단서 없음
det.tip: 회사 전화·메시지 처리 + 동료들에게 당부 → 직장 colleague(동료)
